div.p: Langs Lane connects Bourke and Little Bourke streets between Spencer and King streets. In 1891, Langs Lane was home to around 15 residents and a hide and skin store. In 1930, the Victorian Railways Union, or 'Unity Hall', was located in Langs Lane. From July to October 2007, Langs Lane was host to Wendy Black's art installation, 'Three Minute Attention Span', as part of the City of Melbourne's Laneway Commissions.
